content.passage: Natural resources are raw materials that we get from nature. We use natural resources to make the things we need. For example, we use wood to make tables, stone to build houses, and plants for food. The sun is a natural resource because it gives us solar energy to make electricity. Some natural resources like solar energy are renewable - this means that we can get more of the resource naturally after we use it. But some natural resources are non-renewable.

items.notes: Transcribed from the source book; teacher verification required.

content.question: Why is solar energy considered a renewable resource?
options: Because it runs out quickly when used.
Because we can get more of it naturally after we use it.
Because it is made from coal and oil.
Because it turns into ice when frozen.
content.correctAnswer: Because we can get more of it naturally after we use it.
content.reason: Renewable energy means that the resource can be naturally replenished after use.
